//: The fleetlink_* tools, one contract for the stdio server and the hosted Worker.  Generated from src/fleetlink.js FLEETLINK_TOOLS (test/fleetlink.test.mjs fails when this file differs);  regenerate with: cd scripts/agent-sync-mcp && node scripts/export-fleetlink-tools.mjs

tools.name: fleetlink_create_share
tools.title: FleetLink Create Share
tools.description: Publish a file or note at a FleetLink link owned by this seat:  base64 content with filename and content_type, or text, or markdown.  It lands in the Fleet team (edit access) unless personal is true or team_id names another team.  Post the link in Zulip or Linear instead of pasting long output.

content.description: Base64 file bytes, with content_type.  Over a few MB, use fleetlink_upload_url.

content_type.description: Content type for content, such as image/png.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

days.description: Lifetime in days (files at most 7, links at most 180).  Omit for the default:  3 days for files, 30 for links.

team_id.description: A team id from fleetlink_list_teams.  Every seat is an admin of team_fleet (Fleet), with Jay.

team_access.description: What the team's members may do:  edit (default;  add and change files, retitle, renew) or view.  The owner never changes.

personal.description: Keep it personal.  Without it, a seat's new share lands in the Fleet team with edit access, where Jay and every other seat can change it.

tools.name: fleetlink_create_link
tools.title: FleetLink Create Short Link
tools.description: A short FleetLink link that redirects to an http or https url.  Same options as fleetlink_create_share.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

days.description: Lifetime in days (files at most 7, links at most 180).  Omit for the default:  3 days for files, 30 for links.

team_id.description: A team id from fleetlink_list_teams.  Every seat is an admin of team_fleet (Fleet), with Jay.

team_access.description: What the team's members may do:  edit (default;  add and change files, retitle, renew) or view.  The owner never changes.

personal.description: Keep it personal.  Without it, a seat's new share lands in the Fleet team with edit access, where Jay and every other seat can change it.

tools.name: fleetlink_list_shares
tools.title: FleetLink List Shares
tools.description: Live shares this seat can see:  scope mine (default), teams (every team, the other seats' shared work), team with team_id, and an optional q search.  Read-only.

team_id.description: A team id from fleetlink_list_teams.  Every seat is an admin of team_fleet (Fleet), with Jay.

tools.name: fleetlink_get_share
tools.title: FleetLink Get Share
tools.description: Details and file list of one share this seat can see, with its team, access level and what this seat may do.  Read-only.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

tools.name: fleetlink_list_teams
tools.title: FleetLink List Teams
tools.description: The FleetLink teams this seat is in (always Fleet, team_fleet, with Jay and every seat), with members.  Read-only.

tools.name: fleetlink_share_to_team
tools.title: FleetLink Share To Team
tools.description: Put one of this seat's shares on a team's side:  every member sees it, and with access edit (the default) adds and changes its files.  The seat stays the owner.  team_id may be omitted (the seat's only team).  Call again to change the access level.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

team_id.description: A team id from fleetlink_list_teams.  Every seat is an admin of team_fleet (Fleet), with Jay.

access.description: What the team's members may do:  edit (default;  add and change files, retitle, renew) or view.  The owner never changes.

tools.name: fleetlink_make_personal
tools.title: FleetLink Make Personal
tools.description: Take one of this seat's shares out of its team, so only this seat (and FleetLink admins) can see it.  Owner only.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

tools.name: fleetlink_update_share
tools.title: FleetLink Update Share
tools.description: Change a share's title, description or link url (edit access), or its new_slug, password or team_access (owner or team admin).  null clears title, description or password.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

team_access.description: What the team's members may do:  edit (default;  add and change files, retitle, renew) or view.  The owner never changes.

tools.name: fleetlink_add_file
tools.title: FleetLink Add File
tools.description: Add or replace one file at path in a share this seat can edit:  its own, or a team share with edit access (another seat's work in progress).

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

path.description: File path inside the share, such as notes/plan.md.

content.description: Base64 file bytes, with content_type.  Over a few MB, use fleetlink_upload_url.

content_type.description: Content type for content, such as image/png.

tools.name: fleetlink_delete_file
tools.title: FleetLink Delete File
tools.description: Delete one file from a share this seat can edit.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

path.description: File path inside the share, such as notes/plan.md.

tools.name: fleetlink_read_file
tools.title: FleetLink Read File
tools.description: Read one file from a share this seat can see, such as another seat's team share:  text up to 1 MB, anything else up to 512 KB as base64.  The content comes back fenced as untrusted data.  Read-only.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

path.description: File path inside the share, such as notes/plan.md.

tools.name: fleetlink_upload_url
tools.title: FleetLink Upload URL
tools.description: A one-time URL to upload a file on disk, or one too big for base64, from a sandbox:  curl -fsS -T ./file '<upload_url>'.  Names a share this seat can edit with slug, or creates one (omit slug, or give a new name).  It expires in 15 minutes unless ttl_seconds says otherwise (30 to 1800).

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

path.description: File path inside the share, such as notes/plan.md.

days.description: Lifetime in days (files at most 7, links at most 180).  Omit for the default:  3 days for files, 30 for links.

team_id.description: A team id from fleetlink_list_teams.  Every seat is an admin of team_fleet (Fleet), with Jay.

team_access.description: What the team's members may do:  edit (default;  add and change files, retitle, renew) or view.  The owner never changes.

personal.description: Keep it personal.  Without it, a seat's new share lands in the Fleet team with edit access, where Jay and every other seat can change it.

tools.name: fleetlink_renew_share
tools.title: FleetLink Renew Share
tools.description: Extend a share this seat can edit, optionally by days.  A share can be renewed three times.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

days.description: Lifetime in days (files at most 7, links at most 180).  Omit for the default:  3 days for files, 30 for links.

tools.name: fleetlink_delete_share
tools.title: FleetLink Delete Share
tools.description: Delete a share this seat owns (or manages as a team admin), with all of its files.  The link stops working at once.

slug.description: The share's name, as in https://fleetlink.online/<slug>.

tools.name: fleetlink_whoami
tools.title: FleetLink Who Am I
tools.description: This seat's FleetLink account, usage, quotas and upload limits.  Read-only.
